steps.title: Become an IEEE student member
steps.text: Sign up on the IEEE website using your college email.

steps.title: Add the Computational Intelligence Society
steps.text: Add CIS to your IEEE membership so you count as a member of the chapter.

steps.title: Tell us you've joined
steps.text: Fill in the chapter form so we can add you to the member group and invite you to events.

benefits.title: Hands-on workshops
benefits.text: Machine learning, data science, computer vision, IoT, cloud and security.

benefits.title: Placement preparation
benefits.text: Sessions like Placement Unfiltered on resumes and interviews.

benefits.title: A team to build with
benefits.text: Join a domain team and work on real projects with seniors.

benefits.title: Leadership roles
benefits.text: Run events, design posters or lead a domain as an office bearer.

benefits.title: The IEEE network
benefits.text: Access IEEE and CIS resources and a global professional community.

benefits.title: Competitions
benefits.text: Challenges like ANALYTICA, and support for hackathons like SIH.
